fundSubtitle: If we get $5,000 in donations by July 4th, you vote on what I get inked
fundP1: In January, I launched Heard as a way for people to talk to each other across divides. We've already had 400+ DC residents use it to discuss local matters and now I need to raise a little money.
fundP2: So here's the deal: if Heard raises $5,000 by July 4th, I'll get a temporary tattoo (lasting 1-2 years), voted on by donors.
fundP3: Your donation not only buys you a vote on the design. It also funds my vegan chicken nuggies addiction 🍗 and encourages me as I continue forward with Heard.
fundReadStory: Read the full story on Substack
fundKnowSomeone: Know someone who'd want to help Heard reach its goal? Send them this link.
fundTeaserBody: We're raising $5k by July 4th to pay for flyer printer paper, website costs, and frozen dinners for the founder. Please consider helping us hit our goal!
